links.outcome: Agreement of LLM biologic recommendations with MDT decisions (Cohen kappa) on local patient cohort
links.effect: Poor agreement between MDT decisions and AI recommendations (kappa 0.143-0.213); agreement among AI models weak to moderate (kappa 0.348-0.586); frequent decision-making errors with all AI models.
links.quote: MDT decisions and AI recommendations showed poor agreement (κ = 0.143-0.213).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM biologic-prescribing recommendations against multidisciplinary team decisions as reference standard
Assessing inter-model agreement among multiple LLMs

screen.reason: Retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic/prescribing concordance of five commercial LLMs compared to multidisciplinary team decisions for biologic treatment in severe asthma.
